neighbours.label: aggregation/combination context (adding up, combined with those of, collectively)
fire: Add the scores you assigned to each item in these four areas to get a total.
Each response is combined with those of other teachers and reported by school.
Several pigments collectively absorb most colors of visible light.
The votes from all districts are summed to produce the final tally.
Merge the results from each region into a single national estimate.
Together the three grants cover the full cost of the program.
The individual costs are added up to give the project budget.
Combined with those of her colleagues, her data revealed a clear trend.
quiet: Read the scores you assigned to each item in these four areas once more.
Each response is kept private and never shared with the school.
One pigment absorbs most colors of visible light.
The votes from one district are counted to check the machine.
Review the results from each region before the meeting starts.
Each of the three grants has its own application form.
The individual costs are listed on the back of the form.
Compared with her colleagues, she arrived earlier each day.

notes: No single token; top examples: 'areas' in add-up instruction, 'collectively', 'those of' in combined-with. + output promotes concatenate/summed/merging tokens.
